dialogues.jp: 今日は年に一度の健康診断が行われる日だ。
dialogues.en: Today's the day for the annual physical checkup.
dialogues.text: Today's the day for the annual physical checkup.

dialogues.jp:
なんだかんだと連れ回されるのはかったるいが、
午前中の授業がまるごと潰れるのは中々得な気
分でもある。
dialogues.en: As a result, the afternoon classes were all called off.
dialogues.text: As a result, the afternoon classes were all called off.

dialogues.jp:
そして、どんなつまらない行事でもイベントと
して楽しめる特技を持つ俺と杉並にとっては、
これこそ絶好の機会なのであって……。
dialogues.en:
With that known, Suginami and I were taking to the event
with far more cheer than usual.
dialogues.text:
With that known, Suginami and I were taking to the event
with far more cheer than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふふふ………………この日の為に鍛え鍛えた
　肺活量、見せてやるぜ！」
dialogues.en:
"Fufufu... today, I'd show you the true power of my lung
capacity!"
dialogues.text:
"Fufufu... today, I'd show you the true power of my lung
capacity!"

dialogues.jp: やおら、びしッ、と俺を指差す杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami pointed at me, taunting me.
dialogues.text: Suginami pointed at me, taunting me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉よ！　俺の挑戦、受けて立つか！？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura! Will you stand up to my challenge!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura! Will you stand up to my challenge!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おう、望むところだ！」
dialogues.en: "As you wish!"
dialogues.text: "As you wish!"

dialogues.jp:
俺もまた、大袈裟なポーズで切り返す。売られ
た喧嘩は買うぜ。
dialogues.en:
I made an exaggerated pose in return. We looked more like
two street vendors competing for customers.
dialogues.text:
I made an exaggerated pose in return. We looked more like
two street vendors competing for customers.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よし、今日の昼飯は負けた方のおごりだな！」
dialogues.en: "Good! Today's lunch will be the loser's treat!"
dialogues.text: "Good! Today's lunch will be the loser's treat!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「その言葉、忘れるなよ！！　ほえ面かかせて
　やる！！」
dialogues.en: "Don't you forget those words!! I'm burning up now!!"
dialogues.text: "Don't you forget those words!! I'm burning up now!!"

dialogues.jp:
おごり、という言葉に、俺の闘争心はいやが上
にも燃え上がる。
dialogues.en:
As soon as he mentioned the word "treat", my fighting spirit
started burning.
dialogues.text:
As soon as he mentioned the word "treat", my fighting spirit
started burning.

dialogues.jp: がっしりと手を組み合って、火花を散らす俺達。
dialogues.en: With our arms folded, sparks flew between our gazes.
dialogues.text: With our arms folded, sparks flew between our gazes.

dialogues.speaker: Tahata
dialogues.jp: 「……健康診断と体力測定は違うぞ」
dialogues.en:
"...A physical checkup isn't the same as measuring physical
strength."
dialogues.text:
"...A physical checkup isn't the same as measuring physical
strength."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺達を見て、普段ほとんど言葉を発さな
い田端がぼそりと口を挟んだ。
dialogues.en: Tahata piped in completely unexpectedly while watching us.
dialogues.text: Tahata piped in completely unexpectedly while watching us.

dialogues.jp:
その的を射たツッコミに、ふたりそろって無言
になる。
dialogues.en:
Suginami and I couldn't say anything to such an accurate
remark.
dialogues.text:
Suginami and I couldn't say anything to such an accurate
remark.

dialogues.jp: お前、なかなかおいしい奴だな、田端よ。
dialogues.en: You're a very interesting one, Tahata.
dialogues.text: You're a very interesting one, Tahata.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……ならば診断の結果より不健康な者が飯を
　おごるということでどうだ！？」
dialogues.en:
"...Then how about, the one who's of worse health will be
the one who treats!?"
dialogues.text:
"...Then how about, the one who's of worse health will be
the one who treats!?"

dialogues.jp:
だが、杉並は瞬時に立ち直り、ルールの変更を
提案する。めげない奴だ。
dialogues.en:
But Suginami was quick to regain his composure, and modified
the rules slightly. Quick as always, that guy.
dialogues.text:
But Suginami was quick to regain his composure, and modified
the rules slightly. Quick as always, that guy.

dialogues.jp:
そのエネルギーをもっと人のために使ったら凄
いことができると思うのだが。
dialogues.en:
It would be so much more beneficial to mankind if he
channeled that energy to do better things.
dialogues.text:
It would be so much more beneficial to mankind if he
channeled that energy to do better things.

dialogues.jp: 「なんで『より不健康な者が』なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why "the one who's of worse health"?"
dialogues.text: "Why "the one who's of worse health"?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そりゃ、健康な方が負けじゃいざという時に
　己の腕をへし折るような不正が働かれないと
　も限らんだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Under the previous conditions, any accidental interventions
would be detrimental to one's cause, no?"
dialogues.text:
"Under the previous conditions, any accidental interventions
would be detrimental to one's cause, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「心配しなくても、そんなことするのはお前く
　らいだ」
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to worry, that's more something you would
do."
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to worry, that's more something you would
do."

dialogues.jp:
どう考えても素直に昼飯をおごったほうが安く
すむぞ。
dialogues.en:
As I thought about that more though, my security in my free
lunch started to wane.
dialogues.text:
As I thought about that more though, my security in my free
lunch started to wane.

dialogues.jp:
「……やめようぜもう。何かかったるくなって
　きた。フツーに診断を受けよう」
dialogues.en:
"...On second thought, let's not. Let's just get this
diagnosis over with."
dialogues.text:
"...On second thought, let's not. Let's just get this
diagnosis over with."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ううむ……ただ身体を調べられるだけなぞ面
　白みのない。あまりに受動的に過ぎるな」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm... just a normal physical checkup isn't interesting, if
you take a passive approach like that."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm... just a normal physical checkup isn't interesting, if
you take a passive approach like that."

dialogues.jp:
だから、健康診断っていうのは普通そういうも
んだろうが。
dialogues.en: That's why I'm taking it, just let it be normal...
dialogues.text: That's why I'm taking it, just let it be normal...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？　急に黙って」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong? You're quiet all of a sudden."
dialogues.text: "What's wrong? You're quiet all of a sudden."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや……なんか、いまいち会話のキレが悪い
　ような気がするんだが」
dialogues.en:
"No... I just felt like something was missing in that
conversation."
dialogues.text:
"No... I just felt like something was missing in that
conversation."

dialogues.jp: 俺はぽりぽりと人差し指で頬を｛か／掻｝いた。
dialogues.en: I twisted the finger poked in my cheek a little.
dialogues.text: I twisted the finger poked in my cheek a little.

dialogues.jp:
バカを言い合っている状況は同じなのだが、な
にかこう……一味が足りないような
dialogues.en:
My silly words fitted the situation... there was something
not right.
dialogues.text:
My silly words fitted the situation... there was something
not right.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうさな……オーディエンスからの反応が乏
　しいような気がするな」
dialogues.en:
"Indeed... you have picked up on the lack of audience
involvement."
dialogues.text:
"Indeed... you have picked up on the lack of audience
involvement."

dialogues.jp: 杉並の言葉で、ふと気付く。
dialogues.en: Suginami's line made me realize what it was.
dialogues.text: Suginami's line made me realize what it was.

dialogues.jp: 「そういえば、工藤の姿が見えないな」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah, I haven't seen Kudou today."
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah, I haven't seen Kudou today."

dialogues.jp:
いつも呆れたようなツッコミでこの場をしめて
くれるあいつの姿がなかった。
dialogues.en: The one always playing the tsukkomi hadn't shown up.
dialogues.text: The one always playing the tsukkomi hadn't shown up.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あー。なんか風邪引いたらしくてな」
dialogues.en: "Ahh. Apparently he caught a cold."
dialogues.text: "Ahh. Apparently he caught a cold."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Ahh."
dialogues.text: "Ahh."

dialogues.jp: そうか、それで何か物足りなかったのか。
dialogues.en: Yeah, that must be what was distrbing me.
dialogues.text: Yeah, that must be what was distrbing me.

dialogues.jp:
（……たしか、ずっと前にもこんなことあった
　ような気がするなぁ……）
dialogues.en:
"(...And of course, I didn't notice it until it was
gone...)"
dialogues.text:
"(...And of course, I didn't notice it until it was
gone...)"

dialogues.jp:
なんとなくこの会話にデジャヴュを覚えた俺は、
記憶の糸を手繰り寄せる。
dialogues.en: The conversation also gave me a sudden sense of deja vu.
dialogues.text: The conversation also gave me a sudden sense of deja vu.

dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、工藤ってさ、確か去年の健康診
　断の日にも休んでなかったか？」
dialogues.en:
"Now that you say it, didn't he stay home during last year's
physical examination as well?"
dialogues.text:
"Now that you say it, didn't he stay home during last year's
physical examination as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うむ、そういえばそうだったな」
dialogues.en: "Mm, right you are."
dialogues.text: "Mm, right you are."

dialogues.jp:
頷く杉並の目が怪しく輝く。……この顔は、ま
た何かくだらんことを考えついたのか。
dialogues.en:
As he nodded, his eyes glinted suspiciously. He's thinking
of something now...
dialogues.text:
As he nodded, his eyes glinted suspiciously. He's thinking
of something now...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「もしや工藤の身体には何らかの秘密があって、
　人に見られたくないのでは！？」
dialogues.en:
"In other words, there's something about Kudou's body that
he's been triyng to hide to everyone!"
dialogues.text:
"In other words, there's something about Kudou's body that
he's been triyng to hide to everyone!"

dialogues.jp:
また妄言が始まった、と思いつつも、ついつい
ノッてしまう俺。
dialogues.en: And here comes the conspiracies. I'm so used to this by now.
dialogues.text: And here comes the conspiracies. I'm so used to this by now.

dialogues.jp: 「ほほう……たとえば？」
dialogues.en: "Oh really... and so?"
dialogues.text: "Oh really... and so?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「奴の正体は、未開惑星のレポートを書くため
　にやって来た宇宙人だったりするのかもしれ
　ん」
dialogues.en:
"No doubt his true reason is to report to his home planet on
the uncivilized behaviour of the inhabitants of planet
earth!"
dialogues.text:
"No doubt his true reason is to report to his home planet on
the uncivilized behaviour of the inhabitants of planet
earth!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ははぁ、あの学生服は実は宇宙服だったり」
dialogues.en:
"Haha, and that school uniform is actually a spacesuit,
right."
dialogues.text:
"Haha, and that school uniform is actually a spacesuit,
right."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうそう」
dialogues.en: "Exactly."
dialogues.text: "Exactly."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……ん？　どうした？」
dialogues.en: "...Hm? Something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "...Hm? Something wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや………………やっぱ突っ込みがいないと
　ツラいなと思ってな」
dialogues.en:
".......This really doesn't work well without a tsukkomi to
straighten us out."
dialogues.text:
".......This really doesn't work well without a tsukkomi to
straighten us out."

dialogues.jp: 正直な気持ちでつぶやく俺。
dialogues.en: I muttered my honest feelings.
dialogues.text: I muttered my honest feelings.

dialogues.jp:
この場に工藤がいれば、『お前らなに言ってる
んだよ！』なんて、呆れ顔で場をまとめてくれ
るところなのだが……。
dialogues.en:
In this situation, Kudou would be all "What on earth are you
talking about!", with an exasperated face and all...
dialogues.text:
In this situation, Kudou would be all "What on earth are you
talking about!", with an exasperated face and all...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうか？　これはこれで、放置プレイのよう
　で楽しいが」
dialogues.en:
"You think? I believe it's even better without the missing
actor."
dialogues.text:
"You think? I believe it's even better without the missing
actor."

dialogues.jp: けろりとした顔で答える杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami answered with a straight face.
dialogues.text: Suginami answered with a straight face.

dialogues.jp:
あぁ、駄目だ。コイツはノリツッコミの心って
ものがわかってない。
dialogues.en:
Bah, it's no use. This guy will never understand a
tsukkomi's heart.
dialogues.text:
Bah, it's no use. This guy will never understand a
tsukkomi's heart.

dialogues.jp: 「……ま、いいけどな」
dialogues.en: "...Well, whatever."
dialogues.text: "...Well, whatever."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何を疲れた顔をしてる」
dialogues.en: "You look tired."
dialogues.text: "You look tired."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、なんも」
dialogues.en: "...It's nothing."
dialogues.text: "...It's nothing."

dialogues.speaker: 杉並
dialogues.jp:
「そんな風じゃ悪い診断が出るぞ〜。病は気か
　らだ」
dialogues.en:
"If you stay that way, your physical examination won't go
well~. Perk up."
dialogues.text:
"If you stay that way, your physical examination won't go
well~. Perk up."

dialogues.jp: お前が疲れさせとるんだ、お前が！
dialogues.en: I'm tired because of you, you bastard!
dialogues.text: I'm tired because of you, you bastard!

dialogues.jp:
やはり俺一人じゃコイツの相手は手に余ってし
まう。
dialogues.en: I can't take this guy on by myself.
dialogues.text: I can't take this guy on by myself.

dialogues.jp:
眞子が違うクラスに行ってしまった今に至り、
工藤の有り難味が切実に感じられた。
dialogues.en:
Now that Mako's in a different class, I only have Kudou left
to ally myself with...
dialogues.text:
Now that Mako's in a different class, I only have Kudou left
to ally myself with...

dialogues.jp: （工藤、頼むから早く風邪治してくれ……）
dialogues.en: "(Kudou, please hurry up and get better...)"
dialogues.text: "(Kudou, please hurry up and get better...)"

dialogues.jp: 切に心の中でそう願う。
dialogues.en: I strongly wished so, deep in my heart.
dialogues.text: I strongly wished so, deep in my heart.

dialogues.jp:
結局、飯うんぬんの話は有耶無耶のままに、俺
達は健康診断の会場となる体育館へ向かったの
だった。
dialogues.en:
And in the end, while talking idly about lunch, we headed to
the gymnasium for the physical checkup.
dialogues.text:
And in the end, while talking idly about lunch, we headed to
the gymnasium for the physical checkup.

dialogues.jp: ◆ツッコミ不在◆
dialogues.en: ◆No Tsukkomi◆
dialogues.text: ◆No Tsukkomi◆

dialogues.jp: 今日は身体測定だった。
dialogues.en: Today was physical checkups and measurements day.
dialogues.text: Today was physical checkups and measurements day.

dialogues.jp:
工藤が休みだった為、杉並の相手を一人でする
羽目に……。
dialogues.en:
Since Kudou had taken the day off, I had to fend off
Suginami by myself...
dialogues.text:
Since Kudou had taken the day off, I had to fend off
Suginami by myself...

dialogues.jp:
改めて工藤の存在の有り難さを実感した日だっ
た。工藤、早く戻ってきてくれ。
dialogues.en:
Now that I've finally realzied Kudou's worth, please come
back....
dialogues.text:
Now that I've finally realzied Kudou's worth, please come
back....
